title: Relaunch one_bed_apartment import retry using script file
objective: Relaunch the one_bed_apartment Infinigen-to-SpearSim retry workflow in tmux after the prior retry runner exited before export due to shell/heredoc quoting errors. Use a simple temporary script file and verify export actually starts.
instructions: Do not edit product code and do not perform Git operations.
The existing tmux session spear_one_bed_apartment_import_retry contains failed logs. Start a fresh detached tmux session named spear_one_bed_apartment_import_retry2.

Write a temporary runner script outside the repo, e.g. under /tmp or the Infinigen outputs run directory, then run that script inside tmux. Avoid complex nested heredocs and avoid using read-only shell variable names such as status.

Runner must start at FBX export resolution 512 from /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment/coarse/scene.blend, import to /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Meshes and /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Maps/one_bed_apartment with replacement flags, then cook the target map if import succeeds.

If the 512 import fails with exit 137, killed, OOM, or SIGKILL symptoms, retry once with a fresh 256 export directory and import that. Keep logs per step under /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment_import_retry2_<timestamp>/logs.

Use direct conda env python paths where possible: /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/envs/infinigen/bin/python for Infinigen export and /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/envs/spear-env/bin/python for SPEAR wrapper scripts.
After dispatch, verify tmux capture-pane shows the export step started or the first command is actively running; include attach command, run root, and status in the ResultPacket.
constraints: No commits, no pushes, no PRs.
Do not ask the user to run commands; run them in tmux.
expected_outputs: tmux session spear_one_bed_apartment_import_retry2 running a real retry workflow, not stuck in heredoc or exited before export.
ResultPacket with attach command, target map, run root/log directory, and current state.
definition_of_done: tmux session exists and pane is active or completed with clear final status; if active, pane/logs show export/import/cook started.
